editorial:
Imagine you are a psychic who spends your days helping ghosts find peace. That is the life of our main character, and she seems to have everything under control until she hits a remote house that feels wrong from the second she steps inside. The vibe is super creepy and lonely, making you feel like something is watching her from every dark corner. You get to follow her as she digs into the history of the home, only to realize that the entity living there is way stronger than anything she has ever dealt with before. It starts as a slow burn but quickly turns into a fight for survival.

The acting is great and the twists actually surprise you, though some of the middle parts drag a bit. The jump scares are effective without being cheap, and the final act is a wild ride. If you love ghost stories with a big mystery, you need to see this.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the entity was not a random ghost, but a family member of the psychic who had been waiting for her. In the final scene, the psychic realizes she cannot just push the spirit away. She has to sacrifice her own powers to lock the entity back in the basement forever. She survives, but she loses her ability to see ghosts, ending the movie on a bittersweet note as she finds peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves ghost hunting and twist endings.
